exposure: ultrasound measurement of maternal abdominal subcutaneous and pre-peritoneal fat thickness
outcome: Cesarean delivery due to labor dystocia
cohort: 389 non-diabetic pregnant women scheduled for fetal anatomic survey
finding: Ultrasound measurements of subcutaneous and pre-peritoneal fat, particularly a BFI > 0.5, were associated with a higher risk of developing GDM, hypertensive disorders during pregnancy, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A BFI > 0.8 was associated with a higher risk of cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Median gestational age at ultrasound evaluation was 19.1 weeks
